g.title: native_service
g.text: Native machine service: shared snapshot + typed command socket
near in-process latency with process isolation; the HMI has no NML or HAL link

g.title: cluster_hmi
g.text: no NML link · no HAL link · survives a service restart

g.title: cluster_shared
g.text: same host: shared memory + Unix socket

g.title: cluster_service
g.text: single owner of NML + HAL; restartable independently of the HMI

g.text: command queue · status snapshot · error queue
